title: toona microcarpa var. pilipetala
intro: Toona microcarpa var. pilipetala, commonly known as 'Papaya Tree', is a plant species found in Southeast Asia, belonging to the family Meliaceae. The plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include relief from fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The health benefits of Toona microcarpa var. pilipetala include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in soothing digestive issues and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-arthritic, and anti-ulcerative properties.
